title: Rendezvous with the blues - MELVIN TAYLOR

lines.l: But ain't no use, it's late up to night, I got it, right there with the blue
Day after day, this rain keeps on falling
Night after night, I tried to forget
But you look like nobody else can do
All I've got is that one day new with the blues
The clock says ten past two
Cause all I've got is a rendezvous
Well, the telephone keeps on ringing
Now I got to keep on
Cause all I've got is this
All I've got is this rendezvous
